Thank you to everyone who visited us at the SEGA/ATLUS booth to try out Stellar Blade Complete Edition on the Nintendo Switch 2 for the first time, and to everyone who tuned into our live stage event with @jamm3rd and @seika_ruru  from home!❤️ 

Don't forget! Stellar Blade Complete Edition launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on November 5 PT / November 6 KST, and the demo is available to play right now!
